user.title: Connect Zigbee2MQTT
user.description: Read the existing device and group catalog through Home Assistant MQTT. No commands are sent.

mapping.title: Map two circuits
mapping.description: Select LED controllers, relay channels and an existing group from the catalog. Enter verified temperature ranges and timing values.

error.invalid_mapping: The configuration or physical mapping is invalid.
error.catalog_unavailable: The Zigbee2MQTT device and group catalog is unavailable.

abort.single_instance: Only one Zigbee LED Orchestrator instance is supported.

init.title: Control mode
init.description: Enable active control only when this integration is the sole operational writer for the managed devices. Enabling does not restore previous commands.

error.control_unavailable: Control cannot be enabled until the bridge and a valid topology are available.

pause.name: Pause control
pause.description: Disable control and set every light's desired state to off without publishing.

resume.name: Resume control
resume.description: Restore the mode that was active before the pause. Previous commands are not replayed.

resync.name: Resync catalog
resync.description: Discard observations and re-read the Zigbee2MQTT catalog. Control must be enabled again afterwards.
